summary.en: A minimalist text adventure that grows from a single campfire into a village, a wilderness — and a mystery.
summary.zh: 极简文字冒险，从一堆篝火开始，一步步建立村庄、探索荒野与真相。

description.en: Gather resources, raise buildings and send villagers to work as the story unlocks step by step. There are no graphics at all — everything plays out through text and progress bars.
description.zh: 点击按钮采集资源、建造建筑、派遣村民，剧情随进度解锁；全程无图形，靠文字与进度条推进。

howto.en: Mouse — click to interact, manage resources and follow the story.
howto.zh: 点击交互，管理资源，探索剧情。

tip.en: Second only to 2048 in GitHub stars, with superb polish and a community-made Chinese translation. Text games barely touch your bandwidth and load instantly — the top pick for long-term retention.
tip.zh: Star 数仅次于 2048，口碑与完成度极高，有官方中文版（仓库社区提供）。文字类几乎不耗流量，加载秒开，长留存首选。
